intentional_boundaries: C66 ports LingBot committed feedback lifecycle, not the joint video/action denoising tower.

historical_diagnosis.c57_train_temporal_gap: Training concatenated separately cached local-first-frame H3 K without reindex; rollout changed H3 layout by absolute frame_position.
historical_diagnosis.c57_duplicate_current_gap: Training committed the last current observation into state and also forwarded the same current carrier again.
historical_diagnosis.c57_effect: Heldout MSE relative to D0 -1.166%, win rate 43.75%; C57 is a failed baseline, not promotion evidence.

mechanical-v1 is a permanent INFRA_FAIL: the lean cloud launcher omitted third_party/diffusers_h3/src and exited at the first online-H3 layout import with ModuleNotFoundError before producing a report or model verdict.

mechanical-v2 repeated the old d2 snapshot missing-diffusers failure; mechanical-v3 reached the first H3 linear under h3-int8-native but lacked the cloud NVIDIA library path and exited with CUBLAS_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED. Neither produced a report or verdict.

mechanical-v4 passed the infrastructure preflight and is a permanent MECHANICAL_FAIL: real clean-action feedback at FP32 timestep zero reached a BF16 ActionDiT Linear without autocast and failed mat1 Float versus mat2 BF16 before report generation.

The minimal model fix preserves the FP32 continuous timestep and establishes the same BF16/FP16 autocast boundary used by C58 training inside the public feedback API; a CPU BF16 full feedback-commit regression test covers the repaired path.

mechanical-v5 and mechanical-v6 are permanent INFRA_PREFLIGHT_FAIL runs: the 64x64 BF16/FP16 GEMM probe intermittently returned CUBLAS_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE under nohup, while the same environment sometimes passed interactively, stable 256x256 probes passed in both dtypes, and v4 had already entered real H3 forward. Neither run produced a report, optimizer step, or model verdict.

mechanical-v8-formal and v11 showed that independent 256x256 and even same-process startup-time ActionDiT-width synthetic GEMMs can intermittently fail during CUDA context cold start. All synthetic matmul gates are removed; after CPU identity/data loading, the real frozen H3 and real C58 ActionDiT forwards are the stronger execution gate. The audited v7 pass is final and is not rerun.

mechanical-v7-direct report SHA256 dba327cd41f26596cec23228eb5d4be67ff2fa6a4c354b198271ef48cd87468e passed strict independent audit: all source/model/data hashes match; real H3 K reindex changes temporal phase while V is exact; C58 parity, 30-layer 104-token feedback state, no duplicate current, strict restore and 30/30 finite positive block gradients pass; H3 gradients, optimizer steps and checkpoints are zero.
The audited mechanical/data pass authorizes only a preregistered small-budget episode-disjoint paired canary. It does not authorize long training or fusion.

The implemented canary fixes 8 ranks x 100 steps x microbatch1 = 800 unique train episodes plus 64 heldout episodes, balanced across all four LIBERO suites. Every row retains all seven history chunks, fifteen observations and fifty-six executed actions; no history is truncated or detached. Heldout arms are clean context, action-pair shuffle and context-off under identical model/noise/target.

The first paired-canary-s100 launch is a permanent INFRA_RUNTIME_FAIL: all eight ranks exited at the first real H3 video_patch_proj with PyTorch 2.10 CUDA-13 CUBLAS_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED before step1/loss/optimizer and produced no report/checkpoint. The clean retry uses the node's independently verified PyTorch 2.8 CUDA-12.8 conda runtime plus supplemental Python-only dependencies; every scientific variable remains frozen.

paired-canary-s100-conda-v2 is a permanent INFRA_DEPENDENCY_FAIL before step1/loss/optimizer: the stable conda runtime lacked standalone comfy-kitchen required by ConvRot INT8. Retry v3 adds only isolated comfy-kitchen 0.2.26 (not the ComfyUI execution chain and not the PyTorch-2.10 site-packages); launcher fail-closes on torch/comfy-kitchen versions.
No episode-disjoint clean-vs-history-shuffle C66 result exists.
No C66 rollout is allowed before mechanical and bounded effect gates.

decision.rationale: C66 is not a post-hoc adapter: the committed prefix is read inside all thirty existing C58 attention blocks and clean executed-action K/V is generated by those same blocks. The strict v7-direct audit passes every source, checkpoint, data, lifecycle, restore and gradient gate with zero optimizer steps. Only the fixed 100-step clean/context-off/history-shuffle paired canary is now authorized; effectiveness and LIBERO promotion remain unproven.
